[P1] Preserve occurrence identity for default recomputable archives.
codec/src/main/scala/eyes4s/codec/DensityArchive.scala:270-273 discards the row index while calling the recomputer. The public recomputer at :468-472 rejects every repeated full key. Yet encode defaults to Recomputable (:348) and successfully writes valid completed results with distinct successful maps under a repeated key. materialize traverses each occurrence (:154-156), but cannot reconstruct them through the supplied callback, even with the exact original plan and input. One such key prevents materializing the entire archive. This is separate from the correct AmbiguousKey refusal for a key-only density lookup.

Reproduced with StudyResultFixtures.mixed: both p2/a/recall maps are successful and different. Packed materialize preserves the full result byte-for-byte under canonical result encoding. Default encode -> archive encode -> decode -> materialize(original plan,input) instead returns AmbiguousKey(0,StudyKey(p2,a,recall),2). Preserve a source occurrence/row identity in the recomputation path, or refuse unsupported default archives at encoding with an explicit typed error; do not select the first match or drop rows. Add a duplicate-row recomputable roundtrip regression. Existing duplicate coverage only exercises Packed, and archive law generators use unique keys.
